outcome: Diagnosis of parametrial infiltration in patients with endometriosis (evaluated by sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, and likelihood ratios compared to surgery)
cohort: The study included 164 women with suspected deep endometriosis who were scheduled for surgery.
finding: Ultrasound examination demonstrated good specificity for all parameters but low sensitivity for the anterior and lateral parametria, while clinical examination showed good specificity for anterior and posterior parametria but also low sensitivity for the anterior and lateral parametria.
